subtitle: Unsecured credit. Pay on time and raise your limit.
howItWorksBody: Borrow the credit you need, repay on time and level up. Invite others: every time someone in your network repays, you earn a commission. A missed payment puts your account on hold until settled.
jobCycle2: Repay on time. That interest tops up the pool and pays commissions.
jobCycle3: Level up and borrow a larger amount.
jobCycle4: Invite people who also need money or want to work this.
jobCycle5: Earn from your whole line, every time they borrow and repay. The more active the loop, the more you earn.
securityNote: One loan at a time. Paying on time levels you up. Inviting is the work: commissions come from interest, not from signing people up.
payOnTimeToLevel: Make {count} on-time payments of your unlocked level to rank up
tokenNotEnabled: This token is not enabled on the current contract. A founder can propose enabling it in Admin (72 h). Demo only has USDT.
referralLead: The loop is borrow and repay: that interest funds the pool, you and your network. Each referral adds reputation points. When they repay their first level, you also earn network points; every few points the pool sends you a bonus. The $0.50 gift is one-time at activation. After that, every loan paid in your line pays a commission. People who never borrow or repay earn you no commission.
youAreFounder: You are the founder — root of the whole network
bonusPaid: Already paid to whoever invited you
bonusPending: $0.50 gift when they complete their first level 1 loan
royaltiesFrozen: Commissions suspended. Settle your debt to earn again.
referralHint: You are not in the network yet. Below, in “Activate my credit line”, paste the invite code of who invited you or leave it empty.
invalidSponsor: That invite code is not valid. Leave it empty if you do not have one.
creditActivated: Credit line activated. You can borrow without collateral.
loanIssued: Loan issued without collateral. Pay on time to level up.
paymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed. If it was on time, it counts toward leveling up.
feesWithdrawn: Token fees sent to the collector.
missingProjectIdBody: Create a project at https://dashboard.reown.com and set EXPO_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID in your .env.
activateBeforeLoan: Activate your credit line before requesting a loan
tokenNotEnabledAlert: This token is not enabled on the deployed contract.
cooldownWait: You must wait {time} before requesting another loan.
noActiveLoan: There is no active loan to repay
invalidAmount: The amount is not valid for this token.
connectForInvite: Connect your wallet to get your invite code.
interestRateCurveNote: Level floor {floor}%. Pool utilization raises the rate.
poolLockedNote: Pool funds are not withdrawn: they stay to make loans.
moraBlocked: Account overdue. Settle your debt to operate and receive commissions.
shareDisabledMora: You cannot invite while a payment is overdue.
inviteLinkHint: The link is https so WhatsApp shows it in blue. If the website is not live yet, the link opens Google Play with your code.
referralHistoryLead: See how much you have earned from each person who used your code. That amount rises with the level and the sum they requested and repaid.
referralNone: No one has registered with your code yet.
referralLoadError: The history could not be loaded. Please try again.
notificationLead: The app sends two payment notices per installment: at the midpoint and before the cutoff. Those notices are always on. WhatsApp, Telegram, commissions and new sign-ups are optional.
notificationSaveError: The alert channels could not be saved.
notificationDebtAlways: At mid-term and before the cutoff. No daily reminders.
notificationInvalidPhone: Enter a number with country code, for example +58412…
notificationTelegramHint: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_BOT and run the notification service to finish linking.
debtReminderMid: You are at the midpoint of this installment. You can pay now instead of waiting for the cutoff.
debtReminderCutoff: Payment is due soon. Settle before the cutoff to avoid going overdue.
rankFrameHint: The frame around your photo is your rank banner. Master is the highest.
sectionAccountLead: This is your personal account. Credit and the stablecoins or BNB you receive are yours. The liquidity pool is a separate box: it lives in the contract and is not mixed with this balance.
sectionCreditLineLead: Loans are requested and repaid only from this account. MetaMask and the others are for moving funds in or out.
sectionLoansLead: Every unlocked level stays available. Levels you have not reached appear in gray. Level 10 is the current maximum and still uses the cooldown between loans.
sectionInviteLead: Share your link. New people can borrow, and if they invite, they earn when their people borrow and repay. Overdue accounts cannot invite or earn.
sectionAlertsLead: The app always reminds you at mid-term and before the cutoff. Other channels are optional.
hubCreditLead: Activate, rank and the craft: borrow, repay, level up.
hubLoansLead: Borrow, repay, level up. Each payment turns the loop.
hubNetworkLead: Invites add reputation points. When they borrow and repay, you earn, and the pool may send a bonus.
hubPoolLead: The collective box, not your balance.
hubAdminLead: Only the 3 founding wallets, not credit accounts.
txBusy: An operation is already in progress. Wait until it finishes.
appWalletFailed: This install could not open its wallet. Try again.
amountExceedsBalance: That amount is greater than your account balance.
poolNeedInternalFunds: Add the stablecoin to your account first (Add funds), then contribute to the pool.
appWalletNotReady: This install’s wallet is not ready yet.
sectionPoolLead: The protocol’s collective box. This is not your personal account: if you contribute, the money enters the contract to fund loans and cannot be withdrawn to your wallet.
poolPublicLead: The pool is not your balance. Adding liquidity takes the token from your account and leaves it in the contract to fund loans. That contribution cannot be withdrawn.
poolDestination: Current pool NAV: {amount}. That book value stays in the contract. The administrator does not withdraw it from the app.
adminLead: Max 3 founders. With all 3 on the contract, every change needs 2 signatures and 72 hours: one hacked key cannot move treasury or the 15%. The other two can change the owner, who receives the 15%, and remove the compromised wallet. Pause stays immediate (emergency). KYC and phone are required for everyone and cannot be turned off.
protocolPaused: The protocol is paused. Loans, registration and pool deposits stay stopped until unpause (72h timelock).
confirmWithdrawFees: This sends token fees from the contract to the collector. Continue?
confirmWithdrawBnb: This sends accidental BNB from the contract to the treasury. Continue?
telegramNeedApi: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_NOTIFY_API to link Telegram to your wallet.
pauseProtocolConfirm: This immediately stops loans, registration and deposits. Unpausing requires a proposal, 72 hours and confirmations.
securityPausedBanner: Quatrivium Credit is in emergency pause. New loans, sign-ups and deposits are stopped. You can still repay an active debt.
loanLockedBody: Complete on-time payments at your current level to unlock this amount.
maxLevelNote: Maximum level. The cooldown between loans still applies.
settingsLead: Optional security, profile, appearance and language.
profileLead: The name next to the photo is your username: there is not a second public name. Photo and rank frame are also what the network sees.
profileNamePlaceholder: How your referrals will see you
profileNameInvalid: Use 3 to 20 characters: letter first, then letters, numbers or _.
profilePickPhoto: Choose a photo from the gallery
profileSaved: Your profile was saved. Referrals will see this name.
profileSaveError: The profile could not be saved.
profilePhotoDenied: Quatrivium Credit needs permission to use a gallery photo.
profilePhotoUnavailable: The gallery is not available in this build. Choose an avatar color instead.
referralEarnLevel: Commission if a referral requests and pays this level: {amount} (15% of the interest).
referralEarnLevel1: Gift for bringing them (first $1 payment): {bonus}. Commission if they borrow and repay this level again: {amount}.
referralEarnTitle: Your work: earn when they borrow and repay
referralEarnHint: The bonus is a one-time gift. Commissions come from the interest of each loan anyone in your line requests and repays. That same interest tops up the pool so the loop can continue. A requested loan that is not paid earns nothing.
kycLead: KYC is required for credit. Your real name is already tied to this account. Country, city and document stay on this phone. The chain only stores a yes that you declared.
kycDeclare: I declare that this identifies me. I understand this is not a regulated KYC provider check.
kycDone: Declaration signed. You still need to link your phone to request a loan.
kycNeedBeforeLoan: Complete the identity declaration before requesting a loan.
kycNotGov: Name, ID, location and phone number are not written to the blockchain. The phone number is sent encrypted to the SMS server; the chain only stores a code that cannot be read as a number.
kycToggleOff: KYC is optional in this trial phase.
poolNavExplain: NAV {cash} approximate cash and {loans} lent. The large number is book value, not all cash in the contract.
referralHistoryPartial: This history covers recent blocks. If someone is missing, set EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_START_BLOCK to the deploy block.
networkNotMainnet: This is a real testnet: transactions come from your wallet. Mainnet requires CONFIRM_MAINNET=yes.
lockSettingsLead: The password encrypts the wallet. An optional 6-digit PIN opens the app day to day. After 5 failed tries there is a wait. If you forget the password, restore it with the account email.
lockSetupLead: Create an optional 6-digit PIN for daily unlock. The password is what encrypts the wallet.
lockUnlockLead: Use your PIN or this phone’s fingerprint.
lockUnlockLeadPassword: Type your password. It is checked on this phone.
lockPinMismatch: The PINs do not match. Try again.
lockPinWeak: That PIN is too easy. Do not use repeats, sequences or obvious dates.
lockBiometric: Unlock with fingerprint or Face ID
lockBiometricUnavailable: This phone has no fingerprint or Face ID enrolled.
lockPasswordLead: This password encrypts the key on the phone. You choose the length (at least 8). Do not use a 0x private key.
lockPasswordShowLead: Type a password you can remember. It is not the PIN and not the 12-word secret phrase.
lockPasswordWeak: Use at least 8 characters, with variety. It cannot be a 0x private key.
lockPasswordPrivateKey: Do not use a 0x private key as the app password.
lockPasswordNoEmail: If you forget this password, you can restore it with the email of this account.
lockPasswordNotSeed: You type this key. It is not the 6-digit PIN and not the 12-word secret phrase.
lockPasswordTypeLead: Choose a password and enter it twice. You pick the length. If you lose it, recover it with your email.
onboardLead: Gmail or Proton, a public username and your real name. The real name stays with your credentials and is never shown or written on-chain. KYC and phone come later, before credit.
onboardStepKycPhone: Step 4 of 4 · Identity, location and phone
emailLead: Gmail or Proton Mail only. Notices and the password-reset code go here. After you verify, this mailbox can restore your password.
emailNotAllowed: Use a Gmail or Proton Mail address.
emailDone: Email verified. Notices will go to this address.
emailTaken: That email is already linked to another account.
emailNeedApi: The email cannot be sent now. The worker needs RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM.
emailDeliveryFailed: The email could not be sent. Check Resend on the worker.
emailCodeWrong: The email code is not correct.
emailExpired: The email code expired. Request a new one.
usernameLead: This is the name next to your profile photo. Other people see it. You can change it if the new one is free.
usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: starts with a letter, then letters, numbers or underscore.
usernameLocalOnly: Without the notice server, global uniqueness cannot be checked: the name stays on this phone.
kycLocationPrivate: Location stays on this phone only. It is not written to the blockchain or the public directory.
fundsConfirmLead: If you turn this on, every loan, payment, pool deposit or send asks for PIN or fingerprint.
fundsConfirmPrompt: Confirm with your PIN for this money movement.
deviceBoundTitle: This phone already has an account
deviceBoundBody: This install already has a wallet assigned: {wallet}.
otpLead: The number is required for everyone, just like KYC. It stops multiple accounts. The number is not published on the blockchain: only an irreversible code.
otpWorldNote: We will send a code by SMS or WhatsApp to confirm the number is yours.
otpOptionalNote: The number is required to borrow, just like KYC.
otpFounderExempt: The founder account also registers a phone and KYC.
otpNeedBeforeLoan: Link your phone and this device before requesting a loan.
otpNeedApi: The code cannot be sent right now. Try again later.
otpDeliveryFailed: The code could not be sent. Check Twilio or WhatsApp Cloud API on the worker.
otpRequestFailed: Could not request the code. Reconnect the wallet and try again.
otpExpired: The code expired. Request a new one.
otpPhoneTaken: That number is already bound to another wallet.
otpDeviceTaken: This phone already has a bound wallet.
otpRate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
otpToggleOn: Phone and device are required to borrow.
otpToggleOff: Phone binding is optional in this phase.
appWalletLead: Credit is requested and repaid only here. MetaMask and the others are for moving money in or out of this account.
appWalletPickLead: Choose the wallet you want to use to add or withdraw funds.
appWalletNeedGas: Send a little BNB to this address (from MetaMask, Trust, Binance Web3 or another wallet) to pay transaction gas.
appWalletInLead: In {wallet}, on BNB Smart Chain, send USDT, USDC, FDUSD or BNB to the address above.
appWalletSendLead: Enter the destination address on BNB Smart Chain.
appWalletDestroyLead: If you generate a new account, the current one is closed. Any outstanding credit must be settled. Funds you do not withdraw are assigned to the liquidity pool. Keep your secret phrase if you want to recover access.
appWalletDestroyLoan: Settle the active credit before replacing this account.
appWalletDestroyConfirm: This account will be closed: level, network and any USDT you did not withdraw (it goes to the pool). If you did not keep the secret phrase, you cannot recover this wallet.
appWalletDestroy: Close account and generate a new one
appWalletDestroyed: Account closed. A new wallet was assigned. Username, email and KYC for this account are cleared; they must be created again.
appWalletAdminConnect: Admins: connect an EOA with WalletConnect
appWalletOneAccountHint: Before replacing the account, settle credit and withdraw your funds. Account closure is in Settings → Security.
appWalletReplaceHint: Before replacing this account, settle credit and withdraw your funds. Closure is in Settings → Security.
appWalletTopHint: Unique address for this install. You can add or withdraw funds with MetaMask, Trust, Binance Web3 and other 0x wallets.
kycBannerTodo: Complete identity verification to operate credit, deposits and withdrawals.
kycBannerDone: Identity declared. You can operate with your wallet.
securityLead: KYC and the phone number are required for credit. PIN, fingerprint and secret phrase are optional.
securityKycDone: Declaration signed. You can operate with credit.
securityKycTodo: Complete the form. There is no loan without this verification.
securityPinHint: PIN is on. You can require it when opening the app.
securityPinTodo: Optional. Enable it here if you want to protect access and sensitive actions.
securityPhoneTodo: One number, one account. There is no loan without a phone.
phoneBannerTodo: It is required to borrow, just like KYC.
phoneBannerDone: This number is already linked to your account.
securityPhraseDone: You confirmed that you wrote the phrase down. Keep it off this phone.
securityPhraseTodo: Optional. Write down the 12 words so you can recover access if you change phones.
seedLead: Twelve recovery words. Write them on paper. Whoever has them can control the funds. This is optional; without them there is no way to recover this wallet if you lose the phone.
seedMissing: This install has no phrase. Generate a new account after withdrawing funds if you want to create one.
seedConfirmSaved: I already wrote it down somewhere safe
seedSavedAck: It is recorded that you wrote the phrase down. Keep it off this phone.
seedRestore: Restore with a phrase you already wrote down
seedInvalid: That phrase is not valid. It must be 12 or 24 BIP39 words.
oneAccountLead: This install uses one wallet. If you generate another, the current one is closed. Settle credit and send USDT and BNB to a compatible 0x wallet first. Funds not withdrawn are assigned to the liquidity pool.
lockOnOpenOn: PIN is requested when opening the app
lockOnOpenOff: Ask for PIN when opening the app
lockOnOpenNeedPin: Enable a PIN before requiring unlock on open.
lockCreateOptional: The PIN is required when opening the app. Change it here if you already have one.
kycOpenHint: Tap to open the form and enter your details.
securityAccessKeyLead: The access key is your fingerprint. It is optional: turn it on to unlock the app without typing the PIN.
securityAccessKeyTodo: Optional. Link your fingerprint as the access key.
securityAccessKeyDone: Fingerprint is linked as the access key.
securityAccessKeyFailed: The fingerprint could not be verified. Try again.
seedRotateLead: This deletes the previous phrase and assigns a new wallet. Settle credit and withdraw funds first.
seedRotateConfirm: The current phrase will stop working and a new one will be created. Funds not withdrawn cannot be recovered with the old phrase.
seedRotated: Previous phrase deleted. Write down the new phrase in a safe place.
adminTimelockProposed: Proposal submitted. It can be executed after 72 hours.
adminTimelockConfirm: This does not change the rule today. It opens a proposal that can be executed in 72 hours.
executeAdminDone: The proposal was applied on the contract.
confirmAdminDone: Confirmation recorded. The timelock or more signatures may still be required.
adminAddFoundersLead: Paste a 0x address. Any founder can propose an add, a removal, who receives the 15%, or the withdrawal owner. After 72 hours and the required signatures it applies. Once all 3 are in, the contract requires 2 signatures on every change; it cannot go back to 1.
adminCofounderLead: You can propose adds, removals and who receives the 15%. Confirm or execute the current proposal after the timelock.
adminTwoOfThree: There are 3 founders: the contract requires 2 signatures on every change. A single key cannot lower that quorum. If one key is hacked, the other two remove it.
adminEnableTokenLead: USDT is already set in the constructor. Enable USDC and FDUSD here: 72 h delay, Chainlink oracle and a separate pool each. One loan at a time, in a single token.
settingsAdminLead: In-app credit accounts do not administer the protocol. Connect only the founder EOA or an already authorized cofounder.
settingsAdminOk: Founding wallet recognized. Close settings: the Admin window appears on the home screen.
settingsAdminNot: This EOA is not a founder. User accounts have no admin functions.
payChoiceLead: You choose: pay the installment (based on amount and number of installments) or settle everything at once.
appModeLead: The account is the same in demo and live: username, email, KYC and password do not change. Only the network changes. Demo is a trial with play money. Live uses real USDT, USDC and FDUSD on BSC.
appModeSwitchDemo: This switches to testnet. Your account (username, email, KYC) stays the same. Demo balances and loans are not real money.
appModeSwitchLive: This switches to mainnet. Your account (username, email, KYC) stays the same. From here stablecoins and BNB have real value.
appModeNeedLive: There is no mainnet contract yet. It has to be deployed first.
appModeDemoBannerLead: This is the same account as live. It is a trial: ranks and commissions yes, but this network’s USDT has no real-world value.
appModeStoreLocked: This store build runs only on live BSC. Demo mode is not available.
chooseLanguageLead: The whole app is shown in this language. You can change it later in Settings.
chooseLanguageHint: Tap your language. This screen updates at once. Then tap Done.
rtlNeedsRestart: Arabic and Urdu lay out the screen right to left. Close and reopen the app to apply the layout.
errKycRequired: Complete the identity declaration before requesting a loan.
errIdentityRequired: Link your phone and this device before requesting a loan.
errPhoneTaken: That phone number is already linked to another wallet.
errDeviceTaken: This phone already has a linked wallet. Quatrivium Credit does not allow several accounts on one device.
errDeviceBound: This phone already has an account. Another one cannot be opened on the same device.
errAlreadyBound: This wallet already has a phone and device linked.
errBadAttest: The phone code is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
errExpired: The authentication code expired. Request a new one.
errDailyCap: The protocol daily cap for new loans was reached.
errUtilizationCap: The pool is too utilized. Wait until loans are repaid.
errNoPriceFeed: This token has no oracle. Loans cannot be issued.
errNoContracts: Calls from contracts are not accepted.
errOnlyTimelock: That admin action needs a proposal, 72 hours and confirmations.
errTimelock: The 72-hour timelock has not elapsed yet.
errConfirmations: Other admins still need to confirm.
errSelector: That function cannot be run through governance.
errDelinquent: This wallet is marked delinquent. Repay before borrowing again.
errActiveLoanDestroy: Repay the active loan before destroying this wallet. Remaining funds go to the pool.
errDead: This wallet was already destroyed. Create a new account in the app.
errFounderDestroy: The founder account cannot be destroyed.
errCooldown48h: You must wait 48 hours between one loan and the next.
errInsufficientLiquidity: The pool does not have enough liquidity for this level.
errPegLost: The oracle reports the token lost its peg. Loans are paused.
errStalePrice: The oracle price is stale. Try again later.
errUnsupportedToken: This token is not enabled on the deployed contract.
errTokenMismatch: The token does not match your active loan.
errInsufficientAmount: The amount does not cover the full debt.
errExceedsLp: You cannot withdraw more than your pool position.
errLiquidityInUse: That liquidity is lent out. Wait for repayment or withdraw less.
errInsufficientCash: The pool does not have enough cash for that withdrawal.
errInsufficientPool: There is not enough liquidity in the pool.
errSelfRegister: You can only register your own wallet.
errBlacklisted: This wallet is blocked on the protocol.
errOnlyOwner: Only the contract owner can do this.
errOnlyAdmin: Only a contract admin can do this.
errNoTokenFees: There are no token fees to withdraw.
errNoNative: The contract has no BNB to withdraw.
errRpcMismatch: The RPC network does not match Quatrivium Credit.
errRpcNoContract: The RPC node does not recognize the contract. Try again.
errWrongNetwork: Switch the wallet to the Quatrivium Credit network.
errNeedGas: There is not enough BNB for transaction gas.
errInternalOnly: Credit is requested and repaid only from your Quatrivium account. Use MetaMask or another wallet only to move funds in or out.
errNoAdminProposal: There is no admin proposal to execute.
errTokenNotInApp: This token is not enabled in the app.
createAccountLead: Next you choose a password, confirm your email, then a username (the name next to the profile photo) and your real name (private).
onboardStepNames: Step 2 of 2 · Username and real name
legalNameLead: Your real name is linked to your credentials. Nobody sees it in the app, the directory or the blockchain.
legalNamePrivate: The real name is not shown on the profile, the avatar or the referral network.
kycBoundNote: The original identity is sealed in a digital fingerprint. Changing details on the phone does not recreate the wallet or close the account. Level, network and loans stay. They are only lost if you destroy the account to create another.
lockPasswordMin: At least 8 characters. You choose how long it is. Do not use a 0x private key.
lockRecoverLead: We send a code to the Gmail or Proton address of this account. With that code you choose a new password.
lockRecoverFail: Could not restore the password. Check the email and the code.
referralRepLead: Each referral adds points. Accumulate enough network points and the pool sends you a bonus.
referralRepNext: You need {left} more network points for the next {bonus} bonus.
liquidarLead: If a debtor has an overdue loan, you can liquidate it by paying their debt. You will receive a 5% prize of the principal from the pool. You need to hold the token in your admin wallet.
liquidarAddressPlaceholder: Address of the debtor to liquidate
liquidarConfirm: You will pay this user's debt from your own wallet and receive the 5% prize. This action cannot be undone. Continue?
liquidarDone: Debtor liquidated. Prize sent to your wallet.
marcarMorosoConfirm: This will mark the user as delinquent if their loan is already overdue. It does not pay the debt, only changes the status. Continue?
